stepTitle: Replace Pending Oracle Fixtures With Live Evidence
description: Tracks every oracle-capture fixture that currently carries `captureStatus: pending-external-reference-run` and the live-evidence work required to flip each to `captured`. The replacement work itself happens in each fixture's own write lock; this manifest is the tracker the 02-035 gate consumes to determine completeness.

trackedPendingFixtures.replacementWork: External run of doom/DOOM.EXE captures the 320x200 title screen framebuffer SHA-256.
External run injects ESC, captures framebuffer/state/audio at tic 2.
External run drives the scripted ESC/ENTER/ENTER/DOWN/DOWN/ENTER sequence and captures state at tic 20.
External run captures the E1M1 spawn state snapshot.
External run holds UP-arrow for 35 tics and captures framebuffer+state at tics 0/17/35.
External run drives forward to a door, presses USE, captures state at the USE+0/+1/+70 tics.
External run drives over the E1M1 starting armor and captures the state delta.
External run fires pistol at a zombieman and captures weapon-state and target-health snapshots.
External run drives the death-and-reborn cycle and captures state at health-zero, death-anim end, and reborn tics.
External run reaches the E1M1 exit and captures framebuffer/state at intermission entry and exit.
External run reaches the finale and captures framebuffer/state at finale entry/text-end/cast-end.
External run plays DEMO1 and captures framebuffer/state per the 35-tic schedule.
External run plays DEMO2 and captures framebuffer/state per the 35-tic schedule.
External run plays DEMO3 and captures framebuffer/state per the 35-tic schedule.
External run saves to slot 0, restarts, loads slot 0, and captures state before save / save bytes / state after load.
External run captures WASAPI-loopback SFX windows and music events through E1M1.
External run drives the full E1 deterministic route and captures state every tic / framebuffer every 35 tics / music events.

completionRule: Tracker closes only when every entry's underlying artifact reports `captureStatus: captured` with non-empty entries.
